# Featherbase capability catalog

Featherbase is an agent-first application framework. This catalog links every current capability to its detailed page, accepted specifications, delivery tickets, related capabilities, proving applications and considered alternatives.

Status is judged against the **portable application contract**. Similar behavior in the generic Admin is Partial until an installed application can reuse it without rebuilding the behavior.

## Status key

- **✓ Available**
- **◐ Partial**
- **◇ Planned**
- **○ Not started**
- **! Blocked**

[Request or prioritize a capability](https://github.com/siraj-samsudeen/featherbase/issues/new?title=Capability%20request%3A%20&body=Capability%3A%0A%0AApplication%20or%20workflow%3A%0A%0AWhy%20the%20current%20capabilities%20are%20not%20enough%3A)

## Design options

Design options preserve alternatives and trade-offs without presenting them as promised product features.

| Option | Disposition | Related capability | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Arbitrary component-tree JSON](./capabilities/design-options/arbitrary-component-tree-json.md) | Deferred | [Page intents](./capabilities/page-intents/README.md) | Let declarations describe any nested user-interface component tree rather than a small page-and-block grammar. |
| [Drag-and-drop page builder](./capabilities/design-options/drag-and-drop-page-builder.md) | Deferred | [Page intents](./capabilities/page-intents/README.md) | Add a human visual editor for assembling application pages and blocks. |
| [Visual workflow designer](./capabilities/design-options/visual-workflow-designer.md) | Deferred | [Workflow](./capabilities/runtime-services/workflow.md) | Add a graphical editor for states, transitions, conditions and approvals. |
| [Exhaustive widget catalog](./capabilities/design-options/exhaustive-widget-catalog.md) | Deferred | [Core blocks](./capabilities/core-blocks/README.md) | Predefine a large catalog of specialized visual widgets before applications prove their repeated behavior. |
| [Shared multitenant SaaS runtime](./capabilities/design-options/shared-multitenant-saas-runtime.md) | Deferred | [Packaging and escape hatches](./capabilities/packaging-and-escape-hatches/README.md) | Operate unrelated customers inside one provider-owned Featherbase application runtime and database boundary. |
| [Unrestricted deployment hooks](./capabilities/design-options/unrestricted-deployment-hooks.md) | Rejected | [Packaging and escape hatches](./capabilities/packaging-and-escape-hatches/README.md) | Let installed packages run arbitrary commands during deployment, installation and lifecycle transitions. |
| [Hot code swapping](./capabilities/design-options/hot-code-swapping.md) | Deferred | [Packaging and escape hatches](./capabilities/packaging-and-escape-hatches/README.md) | Replace running application code and transform live state without restarting the application runtime. |
| [One-time generated application](./capabilities/design-options/one-time-generated-application.md) | Rejected | [Runtime application package](./capabilities/packaging-and-escape-hatches/runtime-application-package.md) | Generate a standalone editable codebase from declarations and remove the Featherbase runtime dependency. |
| [Declarative-only migrations](./capabilities/design-options/declarative-only-migrations.md) | Rejected | [Runtime application package](./capabilities/packaging-and-escape-hatches/runtime-application-package.md) | Permit package upgrades to express every schema and data transformation only through framework declarations. |
| [Arbitrary core overrides](./capabilities/design-options/arbitrary-core-overrides.md) | Rejected | [Custom page in the shared shell](./capabilities/packaging-and-escape-hatches/custom-page-shared-shell.md) | Let a package replace any internal Featherbase screen, component or service by name. |
| [Out-of-process application services](./capabilities/design-options/out-of-process-app-services.md) | Deferred | [Notifications and jobs](./capabilities/runtime-services/notifications-jobs.md) | Start every application service as a separate worker or process from the first version. |
| [Package-local upload storage](./capabilities/design-options/package-local-upload-storage.md) | Rejected | [Files](./capabilities/runtime-services/files.md) | Let each application store ordinary customer uploads directly inside its own package directory. |

## Catalog maintenance

- Edit structured frontmatter and explanation on the detailed capability pages.
- Run `pnpm generate:capabilities` to rebuild this index and every generated connection block.
- Run `pnpm check:capabilities` to detect invalid links, relationships, statuses or generated-document drift.
- Accepted specifications remain the behavior authority; GitHub issues remain the work and discussion record.
